about: Langford is a city on Greater Victoria’s West Shore, inland from Esquimalt Harbour at the foot of the Sooke Hills. It has grown rapidly from a rural crossroads into a suburban municipality of new town centres, big-box retail, and hillside housing. Goldstream’s canyon and Bear Mountain sit on the city’s edge. About 47,000 people live in Langford.
seoSummary: Fast-growing West Shore city in Greater Victoria, between Goldstream canyon and the Sooke Hills.
knownFor: Goldstream Provincial Park on the city’s northern edge
Bear Mountain resort and hillside neighbourhoods
Westhills and the Veterans Memorial Parkway corridor

seeAndDo.name: Bear Mountain
seeAndDo.why: Hilltop golf resort and lookout west of the city centre.

seeAndDo.name: City Centre Park
seeAndDo.why: Sports fields, YMCA, and the main civic recreation campus.

seeAndDo.name: Mill Hill Regional Park
seeAndDo.why: Summit trails with views over the West Shore and harbour.

seeAndDo.name: Langford Lake
seeAndDo.why: Urban lake and walking path in the older part of the city.
